ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels on the lateral lobes and 60% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels in the central and posterior regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white pigmentation on the outer distal lobes; a high-contrast isolated black circular blob is situated in the upper-mid section of the right lobe's white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire superior boundary, with pixel-amplitudes varying between 3 and 10 pixels relative to the local edge mean.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the leading margins transitioning into a complex, multi-segmented trailing edge with a general concave-to-straight sweep toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible cluster of high-intensity white circular pixel groups (approx. 4-6 pixels in diameter) on the extreme lateral edge of the left fluke tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single prominent circular black pigmentation mark or lesion on the right lobe; irregular deep indentation on the interior trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The presence of a singular, isolated dark circular focal point within the otherwise white field of the right lobe is the primary distinctive marker.
